template.constraints: Follow NPS journey brief: Proceed → confirm employee details → PRAN yes → 12-digit PRAN → PDF proof upload → Opt IN/OUT → (opt-in) tax regime + % → success. Each phase completes when the bot reaches the NEXT step in the brief, not the final confirmation.
manualPrereqs: Chrome must be open and logged into Google Chat as the test user

variants.name: NPS opt in happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully opt into the National Pension Scheme

phases.description: Say you want NPS and click Proceed on the intro
phases.completionCriteria: Bot shows employee details confirmation (Yes/No) or asks if user has PRAN

phases.description: Confirm employee details Yes, choose has PRAN Yes, enter 12-digit PRAN from testdata
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks to upload PRAN proof document (PDF only)
Bot asks Opt IN or Opt OUT (or tax regime after opt-in)

phases.description: Choose Opt IN, select tax regime and contribution % if asked, until submission success
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms NPS opt-in was submitted successfully

variants.name: NPS opt out happy flow
variants.goal: Successfully opt out of the National Pension Scheme

phases.description: Proceed through NPS intro and confirm employee details
phases.completionCriteria: Bot asks if user has PRAN or shows Opt IN/Opt OUT

phases.description: Enter PRAN if needed, upload proof if asked, choose Opt OUT
phases.completionCriteria: Bot confirms NPS opt-out was submitted successfully
